resources.string: The TBR rate on the main screen is the basal delivered in this many minutes, taken from the AAPS database (temp basals, suspensions and TBR microboluses). Default 30 min.

How many times a command is repeated: the connection to the MedLink, the MedLink write of a command, and a bolus, start or stop that the pump does not apply. After this many in a row, the app warns that the pump probably has an alarm on its screen.

Temp basals below 100% are made by suspending the pump. If the MedLink or the phone runs out of battery while the pump is suspended, nobody starts it again and no basal is delivered.

When either battery is at or below this value, suspensions are not sent, a suspended pump is started again, and a red message in the status bar says which battery is low (it can be dismissed).

Default 5%.

Right after a manual bolus the loop often asks for a low or zero temp basal although BG is still going up.

With this set, during the time after a manual bolus (setting below), when BG is at or above the profile target and the last 5 min delta is above the minimum delta (setting below), any temp basal below this percentage of the pump basal is raised to it, including 0%.

Example: pump basal 1.0 U/h, value 50: a 0% or 30% temp basal becomes 0.5 U/h.

SMB and temp basal microboluses do not start this time. 0 = off.
How long after a manual bolus the minimum basal is applied. Default 180 min (3 h).
Time after the last manual bolus during which the minimum basal after bolus can be applied. After this time the loop temp basals are used as they are.\n\nDefault 180 min (3 h).
The minimum basal after bolus is applied only when the BG change in the last 5 min is above this value (mg/dL).

BG change in the last 5 minutes (delta, in mg/dL, also when the app shows mmol/L) that counts as rising. The minimum basal after bolus is applied only when the delta is above this value.

Examples: 0 = any rise; 2 = more than 2 mg/dL in 5 min.

Default 0.
Amount of seconds between two consecutive BT connections
This is the amount of time, in seconds, that AAPS will wait between two sequential Bluetooth connections. Recommended values are between 5 and 30s.

The profile on the pump is different from the AAPS profile:

%1$s

Accept: save the pump profile as a new local profile and switch to it. DIA and insulin stay as they are.
Cancel: keep the AAPS profile and do not ask again until the pump profile changes.
